name: io.github.BetaNYC/nyc-council-mcp
title: NYC Council
description: NYC Council legislation: bills, hearings, votes and members, from a local index or live Legistar

packageArguments.description: Start the MCP server (the default subcommand)

environmentVariables.name: LEGISTAR_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Free Legistar API token for the live tools. Set this, LEGISTAR_DB_PATH, or both

environmentVariables.name: LEGISTAR_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a legistar.db built with the index subcommand, for the fast local tools
